attributes.comment: A 2D array, in the same size as the data array in the X and Y directions, classifying land, missing, and ice pixels that are all flagged by the same missing_value (specified by the variable attribute _FillValue) in the data array(s), along with water (data) pixels.
This is a container variable that describes the grid_mapping used by the data in this file. This variable does not contain any data; only information about the geographic coordinate system.
This is a data file of the NOAA Coral Reef Watch Daily Global 5km Satellite Sea Surface Temperature Aonomaly product derived using a standard daily climatology of 1991-2020 baseline time period.
